title: Which script produces this output?
examObjective: Applying correct syntax to write DataWeave transformations to coerce, format, order, and filter data
prompt:
The output is XML with `indent=false, writeDeclaration=false`. Given the payload below,

**which script produces exactly this output?**

```
<item id="7">Widget</item>
```

options:
%dw 2.0
output application/xml indent=false, writeDeclaration=false
---
{ item: { id: payload.id, name: payload.name } }

%dw 2.0
output application/xml indent=false, writeDeclaration=false
---
{ item @(id: payload.id): { name: payload.name } }

%dw 2.0
output application/xml indent=false, writeDeclaration=false
---
{ item @(id: payload.id): payload.name }

%dw 2.0
output application/xml indent=false, writeDeclaration=false
---
{ item: payload.name, @id: payload.id }

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/xml indent=false, writeDeclaration=false
---
{ item @(id: payload.id): payload.name }

explanation.approach: Attributes are written with `@( )` directly after the key. The value after the colon becomes the element's content. Writing the id as a field makes a child element instead.
